convert_tf_ops_to_jax: convert TensorFlow graph operations to equivalent JAX functions using the _jax_ops registry
register_custom_tf_operation: register a custom TensorFlow operation with the tf2jax converter using the register_operation decorator
parse_tf_conv2d_to_jax: parse a TensorFlow Conv2D operation with NHWC or NCHW data format into a JAX conv_general_dilated function
handle_tf_control_flow_ops: handle TensorFlow control flow operations like Case, If, and While by converting them to JAX lax.cond and lax.while_loop
convert_tf_random_ops_to_jax: convert TensorFlow random number generation operations to JAX random functions with PRNG key handling
